name: Vinchin Backup & Recovery
description_en:
Vinchin Backup & Recovery is infrastructure backup software for supported virtual, physical, cloud and application workloads. Its current product family also includes replication, continuous protection, migration and verification modules. A platform logo does not establish every feature or license for that platform.

This profile uses VMware image backup and verification as a concrete selection path. It distinguishes a booted recovery copy from a validated business application and separates permanent free coverage from the Enterprise evaluation. No server was installed or restored.
description_zh:
Vinchin Backup & Recovery 是保护受支持虚拟、物理、云及应用工作负载的基础设施备份软件，当前家族另有复制、持续保护、迁移和验证模块。出现平台 Logo 不代表该平台全部功能或许可均包含。

本文以 VMware 镜像备份及验证说明选型，区分副本已启动和业务应用已验证，并区分持续免费范围与 Enterprise 试用，未安装或恢复服务器。

sections.title_en: Follow a backup through storage and recovery
sections.title_zh: 跟踪备份到存储及恢复
sections.en:
The VMware page describes agentless image backups, changed-block tracking, repositories, offsite copies and recovery of a VM or individual files. Source access, transfer path, repository capacity and a compatible target remain deployment requirements.

For a pilot, protect one nonproduction VM, confirm a completed recovery point and restore it to an isolated target with deliberate network settings. Then inspect a file and perform an application read. A configured schedule or host discovery is insufficient evidence that this recovery path works.
sections.zh:
VMware 页面说明无代理镜像备份、变化块跟踪、仓库、异地副本，以及 VM 或单文件恢复。来源访问、传输路径、仓库容量和兼容目标仍是部署要求。

试点可保护一台非生产 VM，确认完整恢复点，再按明确网络设置恢复到隔离目标，检查文件并执行应用读取。配置调度或发现主机不足以证明这条恢复路径可用。

sections.title_en: A boot screenshot answers a narrower question
sections.title_zh: 启动截图只能回答较窄问题
sections.en:
The verification page describes powering on a recovered VM in an isolated lab and assessing a boot screenshot. Jobs can be manual or orchestrated after backup. The lab may use the built-in environment or an integrated virtualization environment.

This can reveal an unbootable recovery point, but a screenshot does not prove database consistency, dependencies or user workflows. Agree additional checks for the application. The homepage’s guaranteed-recovery and universal-migration language is not adopted as an independently verified result; exact source and target versions still need a compatibility check.
sections.zh:
验证页面说明在隔离实验室启动恢复 VM，并检查启动截图，可手工执行或编排在备份之后运行；实验室可使用内置环境或集成虚拟化环境。

这有助发现无法启动的恢复点，但截图不能证明数据库一致性、依赖或用户流程正确。需为应用补充检查。本文不把首页“保证恢复”或通用迁移宣传当作独立验证结果，准确来源和目标版本仍需核对兼容性。

sections.title_zh: 模块采用不同许可单位
sections.en:
The licensing policy describes perpetual and one-to-three-year subscription terms. Units differ by module: VM/socket, physical server, protected TB, user or cloud instance; cross-platform recovery is metered per restoration. Minimum purchases apply. Obtain a scope-specific quote; no numeric product amount was verified.

The policy separately grants a permanent limited Free edition for three VMs and a 60-day Enterprise evaluation. Perpetual use is not perpetual included support: first-year upgrade/maintenance is included, later renewal has separate conditions. Confirm reinstall/reissue and downgrade restrictions before hardware changes.
sections.zh:
许可政策说明永久和一至三年订阅，模块单位分别为 VM／插槽、物理服务器、受保护 TB、用户或云实例，跨平台恢复按恢复次数计量，并有最低购买量。需按范围询价，本次未确认产品数字金额。

政策另有保护三台 VM 的永久有限免费版，以及 60 天 Enterprise 试用。永久使用不等于永久附送支持，首年升级维护包含，后续续费另有条件。硬件变更前应确认重装／重发许可及降级限制。

sections.title_en: Select the workload and recovery objective first
sections.title_zh: 先明确工作负载与恢复目标
sections.en:
Shortlist Vinchin when centralized infrastructure protection and compatible recovery targets match the environment. A desktop file-sync requirement may not justify a backup-server deployment. Inventory actual platforms and versions, allocate storage and privileges, then test restoration and verification before increasing scope.

Detailed failure runbooks, license EULA, application-consistency prerequisites, resource sizing and final support commitments were not verified. No speed, ransomware resistance or migration benchmark was run. Documentation research cannot establish a recovery-time guarantee.
sections.zh:
集中基础设施保护及兼容恢复目标符合环境时，可考虑 Vinchin。桌面文件同步需求未必值得部署备份服务器。应清点实际平台和版本、分配存储与权限，再验证恢复及检查后扩大范围。

本次未确认详细失败手册、EULA、应用一致性前提、资源规格及最终支持承诺，未测试速度、勒索抵抗或迁移性能。文档研究不能证明恢复时限保证。
